description: For 4 different structures (Si, Cu, Al, Fe), generate VASP INCAR files for DOS calculation. The key control is that k-point density must be constant (~50 k-points per Å⁻¹), even though raw structure sizes differ. Other parameters (ISMEAR=0, SIGMA=0.05, NEDOS=2000) must also be uniform across all structures.

kpoint_density_consistency.description: All 4 files must have k-point density ≈ 50 points/Å⁻¹ (not just constant k-point counts)

verification.other_parameters_identical: ISMEAR, SIGMA, NEDOS must be exactly the same across all 4 INCAR files
